title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.00294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. translated_title: LENS-GRF：用于痤疮严重程度分级与多标注者临床Oracle分析的基于门控残差融合的置换不变皮损证据网络
translated_abstract: 自动痤疮严重程度分级既需要全脸上下文信息，也需要细粒度的皮损证据。我们提出了LENS-GRF（基于集合Transformer与门控残差融合的皮损证据网络），这是一个用于四分类痤疮严重程度分级的可解释多阶段框架。该方法将自适应面部皮肤分割和全局Vision Transformer先验与置换不变的皮损集合Transformer相结合，后者对局部皮损图像块和空间几何信息进行编码。门控残差融合自适应地控制局部残差贡献，当门控为零时退化为全局预测。在ACNE04数据集上，配备YOLOv11s的完全自动化LENS-GRF达到了80.82%的准确率；使用真实皮损标注时，达到了95.89% ± 0.59%的准确率和0.9753的二次加权Kappa（Quadratic Weighted Kappa）。数据完整性审计发现了15对跨数据划分的重复图像对，其中五对存在相互冲突的严重程度标签。在锁定的零样本评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出可解释的多阶段框架LENS-GRF，通过置换不变皮损集合Transformer与门控残差融合融合全局与局部信息，实现痤疮严重程度四级自动分级，在ACNE04上使用真实皮损标注达到95.89%准确率和0.9753的二次加权Kappa，并发现数据集中存在重复及标签冲突问题。
en_tdlr: LENS-GRF, an interpretable multi-stage framework combining a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer with Gated Residual Fusion, achieves 95.89% accuracy and a 0.9753 Quadratic Weighted Kappa for four-class acne severity grading on ACNE04 with ground-truth lesion annotations, while uncovering duplicates and label conflicts in the dataset.
